title: Non-local evolution equations with Lévy diffusion: Well-posedness and limiting behavior
summary: In this note we focus our attention on a class of nonlocal-in-time evolution equations with Lévy diffusion, they arise as models of unidirectional viscoelastic fluid flow and physical phenomena with memory effect.We first consider the existence of the classical solution to a nonlocal linear evolution problem under conditions on the involved memory kernels which allows complete positivity.
